raw.buffDescription: When activating a Special Attack, the Defender [k=glossary/power_drain]Power Drains[/k] 50% of the Attacker's Power. Their Special Attack hits [k=glossary/power_burn]Power Burn[/k] 100% of the Attacker's Power, dealing up to 450% of Attack as Direct Damage based on the amount of Power Burnt. This Power Burn can be inflicted through Block at 50% reduced damage.
